WITH store AS (
  SELECT store_id FROM stores WHERE city = 'Ljubljana' AND store_name LIKE '%central%' AND store_name LIKE '%hardware%'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM (
  SELECT 1 FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND si.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store)
  WHERE pf.brand = 'Wavin'
    AND pf.product_family_name = 'Wavin Professional Tigris 31G-M1A Drain Trap and Siphon'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'trap type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'drain trap')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'diameter' AND pvp.property_value_text = '25 mm')
    AND si.available_today_quantity >= 1
  LIMIT 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1 FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND si.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store)
  WHERE pf.brand = 'Castrol'
    AND pf.product_family_name = 'Castrol All Season GTX 3PP-ZPA Engine Oil'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'volume' AND pvp.property_value_text = '250 ml')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'viscosity' AND pvp.property_value_text = '5W-40')
    AND si.available_today_quantity >= 1
  LIMIT 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1 FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND si.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store)
  WHERE pf.brand = 'Osram'
    AND pf.product_family_name = 'Osram Eco Classic 3PW-R88 LED Bulb'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'wattage' AND pvp.property_value_text = '15 W')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'luminous flux' AND pvp.property_value_text = '806 lm')
    AND si.available_today_quantity >= 1
  LIMIT 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1 FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND si.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store)
  WHERE pf.brand = 'Bosch'
    AND pf.product_family_name = 'Bosch Workshop GWS 17A-FAQ Automotive Charger and Bulb'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'product type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'battery charger')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'voltage' AND pvp.property_value_text = '24 V')
    AND si.available_today_quantity >= 1
  LIMIT 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1 FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND si.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store)
  WHERE pf.brand = 'Legrand'
    AND pf.product_family_name = 'Legrand Valena Plexo 2UK-M0J Wiring Device'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'device type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'work light')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'color family' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'Gray')
    AND si.available_today_quantity >= 1
  LIMIT 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 1 FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id
  JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND si.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM store)
  WHERE pf.brand = 'Giacomini'
    AND pf.product_family_name = 'Giacomini R Series R 1PA-6JD Valve and Connector'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'connector type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'ball valve')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'diameter' AND pvp.property_value_text = '32 mm')
    AND si.available_today_quantity >= 1
  LIMIT 1
) sub;
